description: This source file defines the ILifecycleObserver interface in C#. The interface provides methods for handling start and stop lifecycle events with asynchronous operation support via CancellationToken parameters.

classes.name: ILifecycleObserver
classes.description: Interface for lifecycle observers to handle start and stop notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Method to handle start notifications, optionally cancellable via CancellationToken.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Method to handle stop notifications, optionally cancellable via CancellationToken.
